scope: Bounded common API-key/token/private-key/JWT-pattern check over every copied byte; not a general security audit or a guarantee for arbitrary secret encodings. Original independent disclosure/context inspection is retained.
knownSyntheticValues: Independent API fixtures use Buffer.alloc(32,7) as disposable master key with API-key enforcement disabled; PROCESS_START_FAILED is an error label, not an authentication token.
retainedProvenance: Absolute Windows user/runtime/checkout/evidence paths and provider session/process/port identifiers remain intentionally as provenance. No live owner credential was identified or silently redacted.
